translation: Zhongjing also said: When there is no other disease in the zang-organs, but fever with spontaneous sweating arises and is not cured, this is disharmony of the wei-qi, and Guizhi Tang governs it. He also said: The disease of the Yin Wei is suffering from heart pain, and treatment lies at the intersection of the three yin. For the Taiyin pattern use Lizhong Tang (Center-Regulating Decoction), for the Shaoyin pattern use Sini Tang (Frigid Extremities Decoction), and for the Jueyin pattern use Danggui Sini Tang (Angelica Frigid Extremities Decoction) and Wuzhuyu Tang (Evodia Decoction).
